scripts.text:
[ {0} ]
I am waiting for my master.  Brave adventurer, follow your destiny!
scripts.translation:
[ {0} ]
我在等待我的师父。勇敢的冒险者，追随你的命运吧！

scripts.text:
[ {0} ]
I am here to follow ^5533FF{1}^000000's command! Hey! Your not even a part of the guild!!
Where are the guardians? Destroy these intruders!
scripts.translation:
[ {0} ]
我是来服从 ^5533FF{1}^000000 的命令的！嘿！你甚至不是公会的一员！！
守卫在哪里？消灭这些入侵者！

scripts.text:
[ {0} ]
You're not ^5533FF{1}^000000! I am here to follow ^5533FF{2}^000000's command only

[ {0} ]
Welcome Master ^5533FF{1}^000000 ! I will assist you in any way I can!
Kafra Staff Employment / Dismissal
scripts.translation: 雇佣/解雇卡普拉职员

scripts.text: Enter Treasure Room
scripts.translation: 进入宝物室

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[ {0} ]
Master, you don't have a contract with the Kafra Staff Company.
In order to hire a Kafra, you must first learn the Guild skill ^5533FFContract With Kafra^000000.
scripts.translation:
[ {0} ]
师父，您还没有与卡普拉职员公司签订契约。
要雇佣卡普拉职员，您必须先学习公会技能 ^5533FF和卡普拉订契约^000000。

scripts.text: Would you like to employ the services of a Kafra? You will need ^5533FF10,000 Zeny^000000 to do so...
scripts.translation: 您要雇佣卡普拉职员的服务吗？这需要 ^5533FF10,000 泽尼^000000……

scripts.text: Employ Kafra.
scripts.translation: 雇佣卡普拉职员

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[ {0} ]
Master, you do not have enough money to employ a Kafra. Employment has been cancelled.
scripts.translation:
[ {0} ]
师父，您的钱不足以雇佣卡普拉职员。雇佣已取消。

scripts.text:
[ {0} ]
You have created a contract with the Kafra Staff Company.
scripts.translation:
[ {0} ]
您已与卡普拉职员公司签订了契约。

scripts.text:
[ Kafra Staff ]
How do you do? I'm here to provide you with helpful service! I'll do the best I can to serve you.
scripts.translation:
[ 卡普拉职员 ]
您好？我是来为您提供贴心服务的！我会尽全力为您服务。

scripts.text:
[ {0} ]
I think the Kafra Staff will benefit our guild members.
scripts.translation:
[ {0} ]
我认为卡普拉职员会对我们公会成员有益。

scripts.text:
[ {0} ]
As you wish Master.  But I suggest we get a Kafra as soon as possible!
scripts.translation:
[ {0} ]
如您所愿，师父。但我建议我们尽快找一位卡普拉职员！

scripts.text: Would you like to dismiss the current Kafra?
scripts.translation: 您要解雇当前的卡普拉职员吗？

scripts.text: Dismissal
scripts.translation: 解雇

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[ Kafra Staff ]
Have I done anything wrong? If I did, will you please forgive me?
scripts.translation:
[ 卡普拉职员 ]
我做错了什么吗？如果我做错了，请您原谅我好吗？

scripts.text: Dismiss
scripts.translation: 解雇

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[ Kafra Staff ]
It's unfortunate that I won't be able to serve your guild anymore....
scripts.translation:
[ 卡普拉职员 ]
很遗憾我无法再为您的公会服务了……

scripts.text:
[ {0} ]
The Kafra has been dismissed.  But... we should really get a Kafra as soon as possible!
scripts.translation:
[ {0} ]
卡普拉职员已被解雇。但是……我们真的应该尽快再找一位卡普拉职员！

scripts.text:
[ Kafra Staff ]
Thank you master, I'll do my best! ^^.
scripts.translation:
[ 卡普拉职员 ]
谢谢师父，我会尽力的！^^.

scripts.text:
[ {0} ]
Master, I think you should keep the current Kafra Staff because she is already trying her best to serve us
scripts.translation:
[ {0} ]
师父，我认为您应该保留当前的卡普拉职员，因为她已经在尽力为我们服务了

scripts.text:
[ {0} ]
Would you to go to our Treasure Room? Only you, the Guild Master, are allowed to enter this room.
scripts.translation:
[ {0} ]
您要去我们的宝物室吗？只有您，公会会长，才被允许进入这个房间。

scripts.text: Enter Treasure room.
scripts.translation: 进入宝物室

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[ {0} ]
Please follow me through the secret passage way.
You must pull down on the secret switch in order to get out.
scripts.translation:
[ {0} ]
请跟我走这条秘密通道。
你必须拉下秘密开关才能出去。

scripts.text:
[ {0} ]
The goods are produced everyday.
You should get them whenever you can because they might dissapear if you take them at the wrong time.
scripts.translation:
[ {0} ]
货物每天都会生产。
你应该尽可能及时领取，因为如果在错误的时间领取，它们可能会消失。

scripts.text:
[ {0} ]
As you wish, master.
scripts.translation:
[ {0} ]
如您所愿，师父。
